title: L'avenir de l'agence  (The Future of the Agency)

segments.t: Outside the community hall, Gabriel intercepts Mathias to question his aggressive maneuvers behind the scenes. Facing the threat of losing top talent to rival agencies, Gabriel fights to keep ASK afloat. Let's listen to their conversation in French first.
Hé toi, attends une seconde, Mathias!
Ce n'est pas fini pour Auteuil.
Écoute, la situation devient trop compliquée.
Je te tiens au courant demain.
Tu vas céder au chantage maintenant?
Je suis producteur de cinéma maintenant.
Tu dois protéger nos acteurs préférés.
Je choisis le meilleur acteur possible.
Si Dany quitte ASK, nous coulons!
L'agence va commencer à couler vite.
J'appelle Franck pour tout arranger.
Il filtre tous mes appels récents.
Allô Franck? Oui, c'est Gabriel ici.
Bonne chance pour convaincre notre ami!
Let's examine the conversation line by line and explore the French expressions.
Hé toi, attends une seconde, Mathias!
'Hey you, wait a second, Mathias!' Gabriel catches up with the former agent. The imperative 'wait' requests a brief moment.
Ce n'est pas fini pour Auteuil.
'It is not over for Auteuil.' Mathias insists the casting choice is still open. The adjective 'finished' indicates completion.
Écoute, la situation devient trop compliquée.
'Listen, the situation is becoming too complicated.' Gabriel stresses the mounting confusion. The verb 'becomes' means to become.
Je te tiens au courant demain.
'I keep you posted tomorrow.' Mathias promises to share updates later. The idiom 'keep' means to keep someone informed.
Tu vas céder au chantage maintenant?
'Are you going to give in to blackmail now?' Gabriel questions Mathias's ethics. The verb 'ceder' expresses yielding or surrendering.
Je suis producteur de cinéma maintenant.
'I am a cinema producer now.' Mathias underlines his independence from ASK. The noun 'producer' denotes a film producer.
Tu dois protéger nos acteurs préférés.
'You must protect our favorite actors.' Gabriel appeals to their shared history. The adjective 'favorite' expresses preference.
Je choisis le meilleur acteur possible.
'I choose the best actor possible.' Mathias prioritizes artistic criteria. The superlative 'the' means the best.
Si Dany quitte ASK, nous coulons!
'If Dany leaves ASK, we sink!' Gabriel warns of financial ruin. The verb 'sink' figuratively means to sink or go bankrupt.
L'agence va commencer à couler vite.
'The agency will start sinking fast.' Mathias acknowledges the impending danger. The verb phrase 'commencer a' marks the start of an event.
J'appelle Franck pour tout arranger.
'I call Franck to arrange everything.' Gabriel intervenes directly with the talent. The verb 'arrange' means to resolve or sort out.
Il filtre tous mes appels récents.
'He filters all my recent calls.' Mathias warns that Franck is avoiding him. The verb 'filters' means to screen or filter.
Allô Franck? Oui, c'est Gabriel ici.
'Hello Franck? Yes, it is Gabriel here.' Gabriel manages to reach Franck on the phone. The phrase 'c'est Gabriel ici' is common in phone introductions.
Bonne chance pour convaincre notre ami!

'Good luck convincing our friend!' Mathias offers parting encouragement. The prepositional phrase 'good' wishes success. Now let's listen to the complete discussion once more to reinforce the vocabulary.

Gabriel takes initiative to prevent top client Dany Boon from departing ASK. Reaching out to Franck Dubosc directly, Gabriel tries to salvage the agency from collapse. Now, let's review the scene one last time.
